cues.en: All these years, I thought you didn't like me.
cues.ms: Selama ini, aku ingat kau tak suka aku.
cues.zh: 这么多年，我一直以为你不喜欢我。
cues.ko: 그동안 난 네가 날 싫어하는 줄 알았어.

cues.en: Well, you never made it easy.
cues.zh: 你也从来没让这事变得容易啊。

cues.en: You were always too busy competing with me.
cues.ms: Kau selalu sibuk sangat nak bersaing dengan aku.

cues.en: What can I say?
I had to get your attention somehow.
cues.ms: Aku terpaksa cari cara untuk tarik perhatian kau.
cues.zh: 我总得想办法引起你的注意吧。

cues.en: You were always looking at Owen.
cues.zh: 你的眼里总是只有欧文。

cues.en: Oh, please.

You just couldn't stand the thought of losing to Owen,
even when it came to me.
cues.ms:
Kau cuma tak sanggup kalah dengan Owen,
walaupun soal aku.
cues.zh:
你只是受不了输给欧文，
哪怕是在我这件事上。
cues.ko:
넌 그냥 오웬한테 지는 게 싫었던 거야.
나에 관해서조차도.

cues.en: Didn't know early attendance came with a kissing bonus?
cues.ms: Tak sangka datang awal dapat bonus ciuman?
cues.zh: 没想到早到还有接吻福利？
cues.ko: 일찍 오면 키스 보너스도 있는 줄 몰랐네?

cues.en: How did you get in?
Well, my mother-in-law just got back from a business trip.
cues.ms: Mak mentua aku baru pulang dari perjalanan kerja.
cues.zh: 嗯，我丈母娘刚出差回来。

cues.en: She let me in.
Funny.

You never told Raymond what happened
when we shared a room that night.
cues.ms:
Kau tak pernah beritahu Raymond apa yang berlaku
masa kita berkongsi bilik malam itu.
cues.zh:
你从来没告诉雷蒙德，
那晚我们同住一个房间时发生了什么。
cues.ko:
그날 밤 우리가 같은 방 썼을 때 무슨 일 있었는지
레이먼드한테 한 번도 말 안 했지?

cues.en: Nothing happened.
Did it?
Not when you're like this.
Then stay.
I like you, but I don't know how to tell you.
cues.ms: Aku suka kau, tapi aku tak tahu macam mana nak beritahu.
cues.zh: 我喜欢你，但我不知道该怎么告诉你。
cues.ko: 너 좋아해. 근데 어떻게 말해야 할지 모르겠어.

cues.en: I can see that.
I'm just saying, I got to sleep next to him first.
cues.ms: Aku cuma cakap, aku yang dapat tidur sebelah dia dulu.
cues.zh: 我只是说说，我可是先睡在他旁边的。
cues.ko: 그냥 하는 말인데, 그 옆에서 먼저 잔 건 나야.

cues.en: You make it sound like you won a billion dollars.
cues.ms: Cara kau cakap macam kau menang sebilion dolar.
cues.zh: 你说得好像中了十亿大奖一样。

cues.en: Didn't I?
I received your letter.
